name: 西行战记
english_description: A jianghu MUD set against the backdrop of Journey to the West, where new players start at the "South City Inn" in Chang'an and progress through scripture-seeking, demon-slaying, and sect trials. Part of an independent branch of the ES II (Eastern Stories II) architecture, distantly related to several other Journey to the West / ES II MUDs in this collection, it retains classic ES II staples such as message boards, talent-point allocation, and the four core attributes (physique, bone-root, comprehension, spirit), well suited to players who enjoy slow-paced text character progression.
